title: 5 Village Sisters Capture a GIANT Gorilla — Then Cook a Giant Biryani! 😱🔥
description:
A GIANT white gorilla attacks the village — and 5 brave sisters capture it, then cook a giant vegetable biryani for everyone! This village adventure is an epic giant food challenge, from a daring gorilla capture to the biggest biryani feast. 🦍🔥😱

When a gigantic white gorilla storms into the bazaar and sends the stalls flying, the five sisters spring into action — rushing the children and elders to safety behind the courtyard gate. With Dadi's idea, they bring in a crane and a truck to stop the beast.

The first plan fails: the net slips, the gorilla pulls, and the crane's arm buckles. So the sisters switch to plan B — stringing a giant net across a narrow alley, luring the gorilla in, and hauling the ropes tight until the enormous animal is safely captured. No one is hurt, and the gorilla isn't harmed.

With the village safe, Dadi has a plan to celebrate: a giant biryani. The sisters harvest giant bottle gourds and pumpkins, grab fragrant spices, and fire up a huge kadai — oil, whole spices, mountains of giant vegetables and basmati rice all layered into one colossal pot.

When the lid comes off, a cloud of fragrant steam reveals the giant biryani. The whole village gathers to feast, the elders take the first bite — and even the gorilla gets a giant pumpkin of its own. 🦍🍛❤️
